title: Sylvester Chatwell
subtitle: Your own household butler in Grok Bot

steps.title: Point your Bot at the repo
steps.detail: Tell a new Bot: “Set yourself up from github.com/OneManMobile/sylvester-chatwell – follow BOT.md”

steps.title: Give it your nemlig.com login
steps.detail: Take over the Bot’s computer and type the password in its terminal – never in chat

steps.title: Teach it your meal preferences
steps.detail: Diet and allergies, staples, pizza night?

steps.title: Ask for next week’s meal plan
steps.detail: It fills your nemlig basket as it plans, but never orders – you tap Bestil yourself

bonus.title: Ask for a recipe card
bonus.detail: For any day of the plan – kitchen-ready
